questions.markdown:
A factory has the following loads connected to the mains supply of 1-$\Phi$, 415 V, 50 Hz.

i) 40 kVA at 0.75 power factor lagging.
ii) 5 kVA at unity power factor.
iii) 10 kVA at 0.9 power factor leading.

Find the capacitance needed to correct the power factor to 0.9 lagging.

Three identical coils, each of resistance 5 $\Omega$ and inductance 50 mH, are connected in (a) star and, (b) delta to a 415 V, 50 Hz, 3-$\Phi$, ABC supply system. Determine the active, reactive and apparent power in each case. Sketch the power triangle in each case indicating the complex power.

Three similar coils when connected in star across a 400 V, 50 Hz, 3-$\Phi$ supply takes a line current of 10 A at angle of 66.86$^\circ$ with respect to its line voltage. Determine the (i) circuit constants per phase, (ii) power factor, and (iii) complex power drawn from the source.
Using circuit representation, classify the different types of DC machines based on excitation. Considering their salient features, list the applications of each.
With a neat schematic discuss the working principle of a 3-phase digital energy meter.
